annotation.title_clean: COMMISSION REGULATION (EU) No 523/2012 of 20 June 2012 amending Regulation (EC) No 661/2009 as regards the inclusion of certain Regulations of the United Nations Economic Commission for Europe on the type-approval of motor vehicles
annotation.title_en: COMMISSION REGULATION (EU) No 523/2012 of 20 June 2012 amending Regulation (EC) No 661/2009 as regards the inclusion of certain Regulations of the United Nations Economic Commission for Europe on the type-approval of motor vehicles
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 160/8
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Regulation amending Annex IV of Regulation (EC) No 661/2009 to make UNECE Regulations on tyres (Nos 30, 54, 117), tyre pressure monitoring (No 64), braking and other items compulsory for vehicle type-approval. Conventional vehicle safety and tyre rules with no AI or autonomy content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds UNECE Regulations 30, 54, 64 and 117 to compulsory type-approval list in Annex IV
Phased dates 2012-2020 for tyre rolling sound, wet grip and rolling resistance requirements
Mandatory TPMS on M1 vehicles for type-approval from Nov 2012 and for registration/sale from Nov 2014
Clarifies application of UNECE Regulations 13, 13-H, 34 and 55
Transitional 30-month sell-off period for tyres manufactured before the dates
